routing_rule: Record exact serving UIDs. For sparse real load require a subset of the verified ready UID set, not that random low-volume traffic reaches every ready replica.

continuation.measurement_window_rule: max(20, ceil(ceil(10 / frozen_low_rate) / 5) * 5); complete pinned calibration only, same window in every condition.
continuation.qualification_rule: Three passing transport repetitions, all twelve passing model-path controls and four correct warmup answers before all forty-five real-model trials.
continuation.resource_scope: Shared fra6s004 host; separate CPU affinities do not isolate memory bandwidth, caches or other host services.

source_compatibility.scope: Retained load calibration; collection adds ledger bookkeeping and terminal-completion certification. Instrumentation overhead is not assumed zero.
